d:
Bihar ke bhojpur men tatkalin mukhyamantri nitish kumar ki mahatvakankshi yojnaon men shamil ‘har ghar nal ka jal’ yojna ki hakikat najar aa rahi hai. is yojna ka uddeshy gramin parivaron ko ghar tak svachchh peyjal uplabdh karana hai, lekin sarkari davon aur jamini hakikat ke bich ka antar jile ke koeelvar prakhand ki mathurapur panchayat sthit devriya ganv men saph dikhaee de raha hai.
